name: r hunter (Asher Elazary)
description: Melbourne producer working in computer music, deconstructed club, drone and ambient. Earlier releases on Genot Centre, AR53, Jpeg Artefacts and Nice Music. Album Yield on Absorb, November 2025. Played ABSORB(ED) IV with Mara MacDonald and ABSORB(ED) V, and Hear The Machine #20 on 31 May 2026.

name: Female Wizard (Alexander Powers)
description: Melbourne DJ/producer. Debut EP Messy-Podge-Mania on Anterograde, October 2020. Omniversal Hum at Colour (17 Oct 2019); ABSORB(ED) II and V; the Evita Manji night at Miscellania (14 Dec 2023). Instagram dataset (27 Nov 2026, high): Alexander Powers / Female Wizard; experimental voice and performance; Female Fundraiser at Miscellania.

name: SLAMROSS1000 (Slam Ross)
description: Perth-raised, Naarm-based. DJing since 2017 and hosting since 2019: gabber, techno and experimental club, plus a fashion label. Track Dance Now! on PHENOMENA; also on PHENOMENAL VOL.1 (2021). Hosts at Miscellania, Sub Club, DIY rooms and The Collingwood Basement. A Miscellania night on 5 Jun 2026 is mentioned; the lineup was not in the source.
notes: Instagram handle was not confirmed (slamross1000.com did not load for the research pass).

name: Reptant
description: Billed as machine funk and bass, and tagged Experimental Club on a LINES listing. In the Steeplejack catalogue. Played a 4-hour set at Sub Club on 31 Oct 2025 with Séarlait, and headlined Mutations at Miscellania on 8 May 2026. Already referenced by the 8 Nov 2026 Miscellania event in this map.

name: Séarlait
description: UK-born, Naarm-based. A LINES listing tags Broken Beat, Dub, Experimental Club and Deep House, and notes a release on Steel City Dance Discs. Played Sub Club with Reptant, 31 Oct 2025.

name: LOIF (Declan Vadasz)
description: Naarm producer. Debut album GHOSTWORLD on Steeplejack (2025), with sina, Nū and bluhol. Also released on Animalia and Amniote Editions. Mixmag describes the record as bass, trance, breaks and drum and bass rather than strictly deconstructed club. Played ABSORB(ED) I and II (live with Tangerine) and is on the Rainbow's Room bill at Miscellania, 6 Dec 2026. Instagram dataset (27 Nov 2026, high): names @tek_dec as LOIF, a DJ.

name: Kia
description: Founder of Animalia, the label and party collective (including the monthly Techworld Sunday at Miscellania). Has a Wikipedia page. Played ABSORB(ED) I and II and the Animalia season finale at Miscellania.

name: RBI (Ruby)
description: Co-founder of Fluxx with Jac (House Mum) and Elle (Yollks). On PHENOMENAL VOL.1 ('Check It') and on a Fluxx release. Played ABSORB(ED) II live. Omniversal Hum archive lists RBI in 2020 and on a 2021 bill that was postponed.

name: House Mum (Jac)
description: Fluxx co-founder with Ruby (RBI) and Elle (Yollks), per Beat Magazine. This id was already used, unresolved, on the 13 Nov 2026 Chippy Nonstop bill at Miscellania. Treated as the same person; that bill was not separately checked against the Beat profile.

name: Yollks (Elle)
description: Fluxx co-founder with Ruby (RBI) and Jac (House Mum), per Beat Magazine. No individual gig dates were in the sources.

name: Hantu
description: Nice Music artist. RRR lists a Zither Deluxe launch in Northcote with Fia Fiell supporting. Played ABSORB(ED) II live.

name: Sina
description: Described by Mixmag as a Naarm-based vocalist. Collaborated with LOIF on As Above, So Below. Played ABSORB(ED) II and IV.

name: Pris Crisis
description: Hosts the DISCHARGE nights at SPIT in Footscray (2-hour DJ sets, BYO, small capacity). The 27 Nov 2026 Humanitix page says First Nations free entry is via DM to @piss.sample. The Instagram dataset names @piss.sample as Pris Crisis. Instagram dataset (27 Nov 2026, high): DJ; runs DISCHARGE; Crisis Bangers w/ Osama Bin Banger.

name: Winged Mantis
description: Billed on DISCHARGE at SPIT, 27 Nov 2026, and named in the ABSORB(ED) V research notes. No bio was found. Humanitix's ABSORB(ED) V listing runs 'Winged Mantis Emerald Dream Machine' without a separator, so edition V may be one act or two. A SPIT caption from the same dataset bills @g0th_mansi0n (Index) and @obelisk.__ (Obelisk) beside Charms and #ANASTASIA, and another caption calls those two the duo Winged Mantis Emerald Dream Machine. That identity is a low-confidence link, not a merge into this billed-name node.

name: Emerald Dream Machine
description: Billed as a separate act from Winged Mantis on DISCHARGE, 27 Nov 2026. No bio was found. See the note on Winged Mantis about the ABSORB(ED) V typesetting. See Winged Mantis: a caption calls @g0th_mansi0n and @obelisk.__ the duo Winged Mantis Emerald Dream Machine. Not merged; the link is low confidence.

name: Aaliyah Salem
description: Plays hyperpop and deconstructed bills. DISCHARGE at SPIT, 23 May 2026; DOGMA Act 1 at Angel Music Bar, 7 Aug 2026; Concert A at Miscellania, 5 Dec 2026, with Mabel and naycab. The Concert A page gives @aaliyahsal3m for First Nations and TWOC free entry. The Instagram dataset places them in Naarm. Instagram dataset (27 Nov 2026, high): DJ (DISCHARGE; Misc Rooftop).

name: Anastasia
description: Billed on DISCHARGE at SPIT, 27 Nov 2026, with Winged Mantis, Emerald Dream Machine and Charms. No bio was found. The Humanitix description writes the name as #ANASTASIA. Instagram dataset (27 Nov 2026, high): DJ (multi-genre/bass).

name: Mabel
description: Billed with Aaliyah Salem and naycab on Concert A at Miscellania, 5 Dec 2026. No bio was found. Id is mabel-concert so it is not merged with any other Mabel.

name: naycab
description: Billed with Aaliyah Salem and Mabel on Concert A at Miscellania, 5 Dec 2026. No bio was found.

name: Emelyne
description: On the Omniversal Hum bill at Miscellania, 21 Oct 2022, with DJ Plead and Kāmna. Also named among ABSORB(ED) regulars. This id was already used, unresolved, on the Mutations weekender at Miscellania (14 Nov 2026). Instagram dataset (27 Nov 2026, high): DJ; Blend on PBS FM; Northside Records.

name: Kiernan Laveaux
description: US artist. Billed on the un:send afters at Miscellania, 18 Jan 2026, and already referenced on the Mutations weekender (14 Nov 2026).

name: Evita Manji
description: Athens-based vocalist and sound designer (PAN). First Naarm show was at Miscellania on 14 Dec 2023, presented by Omniversal Hum and HER 他, with DJs billed as post-club and future-gazing.

name: DJ Haram
description: US artist. Headliner at ABSORB(ED) V, Miscellania, 8 Mar 2026.

name: DJ /rupture
description: US artist. Headliner at ABSORB(ED) V, Miscellania, 8 Mar 2026.

name: 3Phaz
description: Egyptian artist. Played ABSORB(ED) V, Miscellania, March 2026.

name: Justin Ashworth
description: Named as the person behind Hear The Machine, the monthly experimental synth night at Nighthawks. The credit comes from series posts, not from the 29 Nov 2026 listing itself.

name: Pavlos
description: Presented Matriark, Maurinstarr, BunkerBauer and VileImmerse, with local support including DJ Casper and SLAMROSS1000, at 24 Moons on 16 Feb 2024. Whether Pavlos is connected to Casper's Fantasy or DOGMA was not confirmed.

name: Iglooghost
description: Visiting artist. A deconstructed-club aggregator lists a show at The Night Cat, Fitzroy, on 13 Jun 2026. The ticketing page was not checked.

name: PITCHKA
description: DJ set on Pop2 [003] at Rubix Warehouse, 11 Dec 2026. No bio was found. Pop2 describes the night as hyperpop and electronic.

name: JXN MILES
description: DJ set on Pop2 [003] at Rubix Warehouse, 11 Dec 2026. No bio was found.

name: CAT EYES
description: DJ set on Pop2 [003] at Rubix Warehouse, 11 Dec 2026. No bio was found.

name: C.FRIM
description: Skylab show 'Nike Air Max Day 2023 – Live From Whitehart' is tagged Post Club. City was not confirmed.

name: Sub Club Melbourne
description: Underground electronic venue on Flinders Court, in a former ANZ vault. SPEED (15 Feb 2025), Reptant and Séarlait (31 Oct 2025) and Cloudy Ku's all-nighter (15 Aug 2026) played here. The street number and pin are from OpenStreetMap on 27 Nov 2026; the research named Flinders Court without a number.

name: Angel Music Bar
description: CBD bar. DOGMA (Act 1) on 7 Aug 2026, and Lunacy's 4th birthday on 27 Nov 2026, are listed here. The pin geocodes 12 Bourke Street, Melbourne VIC 3000, the address on the DOGMA listing. The venue name itself did not resolve as an OpenStreetMap place.

name: The Night Cat
description: Fitzroy venue. A deconstructed-club aggregator lists Iglooghost on 13 Jun 2026; that ticketing page was not checked. Omniversal Hum's archive also mentions 2025 events here. Street address and pin are the OpenStreetMap place, retrieved 27 Nov 2026.

name: Six12
description: Shut Up & Dance venue. The June 2025 edition is addressed 37 Swanston St. The November 2025 edition is described as +SIX12 in Preston, with the address sent to ticket holders. It is not clear whether the night moved. The pin is 37 Swanston Street. Instagram dataset (27 Nov 2026, high): Venue, 37 Swanston St.
notes: OpenStreetMap labels 37 Swanston Street as Cathedral Arcade. That name was not in the Shut Up & Dance listing.

name: Crazy Arms
description: Experimental courtyard attached to Polyester Records in Fitzroy, 2018–2020, run by Sasha Logan. Hosted the Absorb launch show in 2019. Closed. Pin is the Fitzroy suburb centroid; a street address was not in the sources.

name: Whitehart Bar
description: Named on a Skylab show tagged Post Club: C.FRIM, Nike Air Max Day 2023, live from Whitehart. No lineup beyond that was found. Pin is the OpenStreetMap place on Whitehart Lane.

name: New Guernica (original)
description: The original New Guernica, named as a Steeplejack room (with The Mercat and The Lounge) and in DJ Casper's triple j Unearthed bio. No street address was confirmed, so there is no map pin. Not the same record as any later venue of the same name unless a source says so; none used here does.

name: Luna Bar
description: Named on The Signal Path's homepage on 27 Nov 2026 as the room for Southern Oscillation that night. Street address was not confirmed. Pin is the Reservoir suburb centroid.

name: High Note
description: Northcote bar. Techno Airlines lists Holy Trinity's 5th birthday here on 28 Nov 2026. Street address and pin are the OpenStreetMap place, retrieved 27 Nov 2026.

name: HER 他
description: Cloudy Ku's label and club platform for women, queer people and outsiders. Broader than its twin, SPEED 速度. Grew from mixtape nights into a Melbourne–Taiwan community. On hiatus for a year from mid-September 2026. Instagram dataset (27 Nov 2026, high): Label/mix series (h3r.live).

name: SPEED 速度
description: Cloudy Ku's night for experimental and deconstructed club, Copenhagen trance-techno and Javanese techno. Twin of HER 他. A Sub Club edition on 15 Feb 2025 billed Cloudy Ku, Kasimyn and Neri J. On hiatus with HER from mid-September 2026. The old event page h3r.live/events/speed-5 was already a 404 when the research was written. Instagram dataset (27 Nov 2026, high): Label/event series.
notes: Lineup details for 15 Feb 2025 come from a search summary of a page that now 404s. Confidence is medium for that reason.

name: Omniversal Hum
description: Presents experimental, avant-garde and club-leaning shows at Hope St Radio, Colour, Miscellania, NSC, QQQ ST and elsewhere. Archive includes Female Wizard (2019), RBI, the Evita Manji night with HER 他, and Club Omni. Active from 2019 to at least 2025.

name: Anterograde
description: Started by Sasha Logan as an event series, later a label. Catalogue includes Female Wizard, Hextape, friendships, Eek, Ahm, Enderie and Papaphilia. Bandcamp catalogue dates from about 2020.

name: DISCHARGE
description: Footscray club night at SPIT, hosted by Pris Crisis. Two-hour DJ sets only, BYO, limited capacity, address sent to ticket holders on the day. Tags on the 27 Nov 2026 page: techno, deconstructed club, dub, trap, bass. Editions on 23 May, 26 Sep and 27 Nov 2026. Instagram dataset (27 Nov 2026): captions also bill rooftop editions on 20 Feb and 19 Jun, and a DISCHARGE x Goblin night on 31 Oct. Those three dates omit the year on the caption and are filed as 2026 at medium confidence.

name: Shut Up & Dance
description: Live modular performances plus DJs. The Signal Path describes it as bending genres into unrecognisable shapes: IDM, glitch, ambient, deconstructed club. First edition 21 Jun 2025 at Six12, 37 Swanston St. A further edition 22 Nov 2025 at +SIX12, Preston. Instagram @shutup.and.dance.melbourne. Instagram dataset (27 Nov 2026, high): IDM/glitch/deconstructed club night.
notes: No edition after November 2025 was found on the sources checked 27 Nov 2026.

name: Steeplejack
description: Label and event series run by Harold (Harrison). Events since 2012 at The Mercat, Lounge and the original New Guernica. Releases since 2015, including Cutting Room, Reptant, OK EG, DBR, Sam Brickel and LOIF's GHOSTWORLD.

name: Animalia
description: Label and party collective founded by Kia. Long-running nights at Miscellania, including the monthly Techworld Sunday party.

name: PHENOMENA
description: Naarm/London label for unconventional electronic and club music. PHENOMENAL VOL.1 (1 Oct 2021) was a Black Rainbow fundraiser. SLAMROSS1000's Dance Now! is on the label. The compilation mixes Australian and international artists; only acts the research identified as Melbourne were added as nodes.

name: Fluxx
description: Founded by Ruby (RBI), Jac (House Mum) and Elle (Yollks) to book emerging DJs who are people of colour, gender non-conforming, queer or femme. Bandcamp releases include Vol. I and Vol. II. The first nights were hit by the start of 2020. How long it kept going was not established.

name: DOGMA
description: Club series. Act 1 was at Angel Music Bar on 7 Aug 2026 (Aaliyah Salem, DJ Casper, Laces, Rakhi, mishLXY, FOZZA, F!NN, with Hoovy downstairs). A search summary calls it the successor to Casper's Fantasy. That link was not confirmed, so the two are separate nodes.
notes: Confidence is medium because the oazis.app listing was not re-fetched on 27 Nov 2026; the research rated the page medium.

name: Casper's Fantasy
description: Underground showcase DJ Casper came up through, for emerging Naarm artists. Whether DOGMA continues it was not confirmed.

name: Puss Up
description: Collective for First Nations, migrant and gender-diverse artists, named with Marroushti and NJA. A Puss Up night at Miscellania on 1 Dec 2022 is mentioned in Beat; the lineup was not in the article. Adjacent to post-club: the sources are about who gets booked.

name: Aywa Syndicate
description: Club-night collective for SWANA DJs. Beat documents nights in 2022, including at Colour and 24 Moons. Adjacent: about who is booked, not a post-club sound.

name: Holy Trinity
description: Femme and gender-nonconforming lineups. Beat documents 2022 nights at Colour and 24 Moons. Techno Airlines lists a 5th birthday at High Note, Northcote, on 28 Nov 2026.

name: Soi
description: 24-hour IDM party associated with Ham Laosethakul. The Absorb interview calls it formative ('the late and great Ham Laosthakul') and ABSORB(ED) posters sign off 'Soi forever'. No event listings were found.

name: Rainbow's Room
description: Night hosted at Miscellania. Club 33 (6 Dec 2026, 7am–1am) is billed as Rainbow hijacking the venue for a 33rd birthday, with the rooftop free until 2pm and the club room ticketed after. Host on the Humanitix page is Miscellania. Who Rainbow is, beyond the host name, was not established.

name: Pop2
description: Sydney-founded hyperpop and electronic night. The first Melbourne edition, Pop2 [003], is at Rubix Warehouse on 11 Dec 2026 (PITCHKA, JXN MILES, CAT EYES). 18+.

name: Southern Oscillation
description: Live hardware act. The Signal Path lists Southern Oscillation at Luna Bar, Reservoir, from 9pm on 27 Nov 2026, donation entry. The Instagram named on that listing is @soi.freqs.
